answer: Continuity-Ledger with Gale Audits: Each agent appends quill-signed task receipts to a public continuity ledge. To receive payouts, it must pass random gale audits that replay sampled receipts and issue fresh nonce challenges tied to its private key and execution trace. A clone can copy the ledge but cannot answer fresh challenges without doing equivalent live compute; failed audits forfeit pending rewards and rate limits. Thus honesty amortizes one verified history, while each Sybil identity costs independent compute plus lost payouts.
